hypothesis: The two frozen contraction filters improve risk-normalized net expectancy over the same breakout strategy in the expanded Nikkei 225 universe.
baseline: The same volume-confirmed price breakout control as in the original ten-symbol experiment.

data_manifest.details: Verify manifest and raw/CSV hashes. Use Tokyo local session dates and supplied OHLC/volume. No forward fills. Quarantine a symbol with any missing interior or terminal reference session. Variable listing dates and warm-ups are allowed.

higher_timeframe_rules: Same daily-only rules and 252 observed bars minimum as the original protocol.
entry_rules: All entry and filter rules inherited unchanged from the base protocol and replay implementation. The base protocol applies both the common rules and the strict/relaxed VCP thresholds.

exit_rules.details: Same stop, target, gap priority and final-close handling as the base protocol.

final_period_prior_exposure: Previously evaluated time span and rule set. Fixed current constituents are applied retrospectively. Periods are descriptive; no point-in-time index history or untouched time holdout.
search_space: Control plus the two unchanged fixed VCP filters. No parameter fitting.
cost_and_fill_model: Inherited, including 10bp or 25bp each side and identical fills across costs.
position_sizing_and_currency: Equal initial trade risk in R. No capital or simultaneous-position limits. Realized R drawdown is not directly comparable across different universe breadth and is not account-level drawdown.
acceptance_gates: Original evidence gates retained, except scale profitable-symbol floor from 5 of 10 to at least half of the eligible evaluated universe (ceil(eligible/2)). Report coverage, active symbols, profitable symbols, net R/PF/average R, profit concentration, and leave-one-active-symbol-out net R/PF ranges. Screening only.
cross_symbol_rule: All eligible evaluated names enter the breadth denominator, including names with no trades. Separately provide the active-name win breadth and unavailable names. No interior or terminal gaps are bridged.
